invariant_evidence: Executor durably consumes and read-back verifies the exact repository-backed Dispatch Claim before Secret decryption or entry into the already-selected Adapter dispatch port.
A crash after Claim consumption is at-most-once: restart from DISPATCH_CLAIMED performs reconciliation only and cannot release Secret plaintext or replay Adapter submission.

The package exports no Broker, callback, or caller-constructible Secret channel; only Executor's private composition-root-fixed dispatch transaction can reach SecretStore's internal resolver and fixed Adapter port.

The transaction derives the complete Secret set from trusted Decision and Grant repositories after Claim consumption, releases each value once into bounded mutable buffers, and zeroes every buffer on success or failure.
The durable SQLite generation backend atomically persists HMAC-authenticated anchors and encrypted immutable blobs with generation, state-digest, prior-anchor, namespace, and path-identity bindings.
Production Audit Head and Wrapped Key constructors accept only one shared durable anchor/blob backend; integer-only and in-memory fallbacks are rejected, while restart and tamper tests fail closed.

Recovery loads and read-back verifies the SecureIngestionManifest, result projection, every referenced Artifact and Secret, and the deletion intent before it constructs a sink or explicitly resumes Quarantine erasure.

After durable ingestion or erasure, Executor rebuilds ExecutionResult from the verified projection and manifest without calling Adapter collection again; Quarantine constructors and lookups perform no recovery writes.

Executor owns an injected trusted Clock and exposes no caller timestamp on collection or ingestion; one Clock reading persists collection_started_at, retention_until, and the collection lease for restart reuse.
The authority binds the exact ToolRef, Registry digest, Provider task and deterministic sink, and max_result_bytes is the minimum of that ToolDefinition limit and the system hard cap.
The application coordinator accepts only ingestion_id and loads the canonical Receipt, Execution, Result Collection Authority, Mission and quarantine stream from trusted repositories.
Strict immutable Dispatch Claim, collection authority, manifest, deletion-intent and generation-anchor models reject unknown fields, coercion and digest/row binding changes.
The Phase 0B isolated Mock ingester remains an exact test-double exception while non-mock ingestion requires the durable Phase 0C erasure state machine.
Phase 0B flow/safety regressions and Phase 0C positive, denial, crash, restart, retention, path-replacement and corrupt-blob cases remain covered.

notes: This audit is rebound to the current authorized Phase 0C implementation request after the trusted exact-HEAD base refresh. It covers all six retained P1 findings as one durable lifecycle correction: Executor-owned consume-before-decrypt Secret delivery, manifest-and-resource verification before explicit erasure, projection-only post-erasure result recovery, trusted Clock ownership, and a durable production generation backend. No external provider or target action is introduced.
